name: auriga-cli
description: Plugins shipped by the auriga-cli Claude Code harness (auriga-go workflow autopilot, etc.)

plugins.name: auriga-go
plugins.description: Workflow autopilot for the auriga workflow. Reminder-based navigation across the 12 CLAUDE.md phases; includes an Experimental hook-backed `ship` mode that drives a small-scope spec to PR Ready.

plugins.name: auriga-pr-guards
plugins.description: PR-create snapshot inject (PostToolUse) + PR-ready structural block (PreToolUse) for `gh pr create` / `gh pr ready`. Dual-Agent compatible (Claude Code + Codex).

plugins.name: agents-md-ancestor-loader
plugins.description: Codex SessionStart hook that injects AGENTS.md files from ancestor directories above Codex's built-in project-root boundary.
